title: Badminton: Laborte helps win first men's doubles crown for Ateneo

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebuano badminton standout Lyrden Laborte steered the Ateneo de Manila University Blue Eagles to their first-ever men’s doubles championship in the inaugural three-event format of the UAAP Badminton Tournament on Tuesday, November 3. Ateneo settled for second place in the men’s overall standings, but Laborte gave the Blue Eagles a historic achievement by teaming up with co-captain Robby Ramos to capture the men’s doubles gold medal. Their match took place at Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City. The duo prevented the National University (NU) from completing a sweep of the men’s gold medals with a convincing 21–13, 21–15 victory […]...
